entities.summary: Established in 1997, Koforidua Technical University is one of Ghana's ten regional Technical Universities. Since 1999 it has produced graduates with HNDs in Accountancy,, marketing, purchasing and supply, statistics, and computer science, and currently offers degree programmes.
